user.title: Your electricity contract
user.description:
Corrente works out your electricity price from your contract and the Italian time bands (F1, F2, F3).

Switzerland and PUN-indexed contracts are coming soon. Missing something? [Suggest a change]({issues_url}). Corrente is free — [buy us a coffee]({donate_url}) ☕

prices_single.title: Prices per kWh
prices_single.description: Enter the energy prices from your bill, in €/kWh (for example 0.1250). Not sure where to find them? [Ask here]({issues_url}).
